links.outcome: GP need for training and understanding of generative AI
links.effect: 80% of GPs expressed a need for more training in understanding generative AI tools; many reported lack of knowledge and experience.
links.quote: 80% of respondents expressed a need for more training in understanding these tools.

links.outcome: GP use of unsanctioned non-medical-grade AI for clinical tasks
links.effect: One-fifth of GPs reported having used AI for clinical practice; a portion used non-medical grade technology for clinical tasks.
links.quote: Many GPs reported a lack of knowledge and experience with this technology, although a portion already used non-medical grade technology for clinical tasks, with the risks that this entails.

screen.reason: Empirical mixed-methods survey of UK general practitioners exploring actual use, attitudes, training needs, and safety/equity concerns regarding generative AI in clinical practice.
